description:
The ultralight 20" woom OFF 4 features a carbon fork and child-specific ergonomics built for light singletrack and off-road paths. Featuring our latest component updates and refined engineering for young mountain bikers aged 6 and up.
Looking for our previous version? Use the selector below to toggle between the Newest Model and our 2023 Model.

groupset.description: MicroSHIFT Advent 9-Speed with fine-tuned gear ratios

components.description: Cr-Mo axle and sealed industrial-grade ball bearings
Hydraulic disc brakes Tektro HD-J3120; Rotor diameter front/back: 140/140 mm; Ergonomic short-reach brake levers designed for children's hands
Active Motion Clutch eliminates chain slap and prevents chain drops for whisper-quiet rides without interruption.
Narrow-wide chainring with 28 teeth
Cassette with 11–36 teeth
Lightweight forged aluminum 110 mm cranks with narrow Q-factor
Short cage rear derailleurs for maximum ground clearance:
Lightweight woom carbon fork; Multidirectional carbon fibers for high torsional stiffness; 1 1/8″ – 1″ baby taper steerer tube; 100 × 15 mm thru-axle; Post mount for disc brake
Child-friendly because of a small diameter; Single-clamp grip to prevent twisting; Safety zone: extra rubber on the palm-facing portion of the grip for added comfort; 100% silicone for maximum grip
Wide, ergonomically adapted and lightweight aluminum bars for more control; Tapered end to fit a child’s hand; Sandblasted and silver anodized; Width: 570 mm; Rise: 20 mm
Fully integrated 1 – 1 ⅛" headset; Sealed industrial bearings
4 mm hex key for the stem and seatpost clamp; 8 mm hex key for the front wheel and pedals
Platform pedals made from fiber-reinforced nylon with metal pins for added grip
Ergonomically designed to fit a child’s anatomy; Streamlined, mountain-bike-specific saddle design; Side protection to lean against walls
27.2 x 250 mm; Anodized aluminum seatpost with insertion marks that indicate the minimum insertion depth; Quick-release seatpost clamp
Quick-release seatpost clamp for easy adjustments; Made from aluminum
Precise, Kid-Centric Shifting; MS Advent Trigger SL-M6195-R with short-reach rubber pad levers. Lower shifting force to quickly and effortlessly change gears.
Forged aluminum; CNC-machined; Handlebars attached via two clamps; Rise/drop: +/-15° with flip-flop design to adjust the handlebar height; Length: 50 mm

20 × 2.25" Schwalbe Rocket Ron Performance ADDIX GREEN - combines speed and cornering control at the highest possible level. Cleverly designed tread balanced for low rolling resistance while remaining grippy; Presta valves

Lightweight aluminum rims from Alexrims; Size: 20″; Aluminum hubs with sealed industrial bearings; Thru-axles for maximum torsional strength (100 × 15 mm front / 135 × 12 mm rear); 20 spokes, double-crossed spoking; Aluminum nipples
